BriefDescription: Counts cycles in which an address-generation interlock occurs
Counts cycles in which a long-latency interlock occurs
Counts cyles in which a CSR interlock
Counts cycles in which the instruction cache is not able to provide instructions
Counts cycles in which the data cache is not able to provide data to a waiting instruction

Counts the number of times a replay was performed for memory accesses
Counts the number of times an interlock occurred with the multiply or divide block
Counts the number of times an interlock with the floating-point unit occurred
